# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_REVERSAL_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price breaks the opening range and then reverts to VWAP within the first 20 minutes, it signals institutional mean-reversion offering a long edge. This structure captures the fade of initial imbalances as liquidity providers step in to restore fair value.

## Mechanism

Entry: If the 5-minute bar’s close exceeds the opening range high (ORH) and thereafter price closes below the 20-period VWAP (cross from above to below VWAP), enter long at the close of that bar.  
Exit: Chart-stop at ORH (invalidation of break), primary target at 1.5× risk or prior day’s high (whichever hits first).  
Regime filter: Only active when VIX < 15 and within first 60 minutes after open.
